# Pinned family-dev-handbook corpus

`README.md`, `README.ja.md`, and `docs/05-fail-posture.md` are byte-for-byte copies from
`caty-ai/family-dev-handbook@49be5f3c2b3ff84415bc8335111504c4fc36b69a`.
The root-level subset keeps OC-B and OC-C tied to a fixed public-HEAD shape;
the absent zh/th files are real corpus inputs, not generated defects. The one
`docs/0*.md` file carries stable `FP-*` rule IDs so the OC-H handbook-index
extractor has a pinned, nonzero real-corpus assertion.
